actual_scope: Geometric multiplicity, over Q, of eigenvalue 0 of A_1 on the pinned 216-dimensional joint (+1,+1) eigenspace of the c=1 sign stabilizer and the involutions g and t.
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for a formal caller or certificate binding. Open question 2 of the characteristic-polynomial package, merged as PR #6964, asks for the geometric multiplicity of eigenvalue 0 on the pinned 216-by-216 matrix. A modular rank is only a lower bound. This package computes the rational nullity and the matching algebraic multiplicity by ascent. It does not add a Lean binding.
bottleneck_link: Scoped side result on the historical centre Gram. The selected conditional kappa remains 781451/250000000. The one-slot minimal polynomial remains degree 881 in research/exact-one-slot-gram/; this rank locates the 0-eigenspace inside the degree-216 characteristic polynomial and does not replace that certificate.
stop_rule: Stop once the rational rank of the pinned 216-by-216 matrix is certified by an integer kernel and a nonzero maximal minor, and the ascent of eigenvalue 0 is compared with the recorded factor x^24. Do not recompute the characteristic polynomial, the other three joint matrices, or eigenvalue 2.
evidence: verify.py recomputes the kernel of the pinned matrix. Marker PASS_A1_JOINT_216_NULLITY. Rational rank 192, geometric multiplicity 24, algebraic multiplicity 24. Kernel SHA256 4eefc84f2750988bfe22056387b427fd9de1c09093c6e4be480ffe209b207714. Selected baseline returned PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY.

open_questions.question: What is the geometric multiplicity of eigenvalue 2 of A_1 on this same pinned 216-dimensional space?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The recorded characteristic polynomial gives algebraic multiplicity 12 for eigenvalue 2. The rational nullity of M - 8 I is the geometric multiplicity.
open_questions.first_step: Repeat this kernel certificate on the pinned matrix shifted by 8 I.
open_questions.blocked_by: This package stops at eigenvalue 0. The shifted elimination was not run.

open_questions.question: What is the geometric multiplicity of eigenvalue 0 on each of the other three joint sign spaces?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The predecessor proves those spaces have the same characteristic polynomial, so the algebraic multiplicity is 24 on each. Their matrices are separate operators.
open_questions.first_step: Export one other joint sign matrix from the same restriction and repeat the integer kernel certificate.
open_questions.blocked_by: Those three matrices are not pinned. The scaling identity was checked only on the (+1,+1) basis.

overlap.limits: GitHub pull-request search for geometric multiplicity returned only merged PR #6964. Open PR #7008 records isotypic dimensions and does not compute this nullity. Open PR #7009 treats different sign characters. The remote overlap cache was not refreshed.
